rule_text.name: 702.247a
rule_text.rule: Slipstream is an evasion ability. A creature with slipstream can't be blocked as long as each attacking creature has slipstream.

rule_text.name: 702.247b
rule_text.rule: If creatures with and without slipstream are attacking and then each attacking creature without slipstream is removed from combat, creatures with slipstream can't be blocked. However, if blockers have already been declared, those creatures will still be blocked.
